text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!?)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Wh... What...
She's so strong...!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"See, what did I tell you?! What did I tell you?!
Mejiro Ramonu really is the strongest!!"

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
W-Who dared doubt her?!
Distance categories don't mean a thing, Ramonu...-sama!
Is the real deal!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: Lady Mejiro Ramonuuuuu—!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Such vivid, raw colors.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A relentless, murderous intent
chasing right after me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"In the midst of the struggle for love...
I was there."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu looks more enraptured than usual.
It seems that high-level race stimulated her immensely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —More.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Can I aim for even greater heights?
Can I have even more fun?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Can I love "you"...
even more?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A Classic Triple Crown Umamusume...
If she's my opponent—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: âRamonu!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bounding into view was Mr. C.B.
She wore an excited expression, as if she had been running until just a moment ago—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"If you want a Triple Crown Umamusume,
she's standing right in front of you!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "You make me... soooo restless!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—I want to run with you.
I want to face you in an all-out race!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Cup!
Let's pick up where we left off that day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I love you, CB.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Your heat...
it's completely overwhelming me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I accept.
I will savor... the serious you.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Wait... What does this mean?
Triple Crown Umamusume Mr. C.B. and—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu is gonna race?!
Wait, what, seriously... for real?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooooooah...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The loudest cheer of the day erupted. And just like that,
the showdown between Mejiro Ramonu and Mr. C.B.
was set at a dream-like timing...!

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Man... that turned into something incredible!
I guess that's the power of Ramonu-san's charm, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...Because she is a truly perfect Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Shall we move along as well? The representatives from each field are waiting for us at a separate venue.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad, though! Ramonu-san's declaration
took me by surprise, but thanks to it, far more people
have taken an interest in the race—

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Now you can finally start working on that vision you've had
for elevating the racing world.
Things are about to get very busy!

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Rudolf-san?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me.
Let us head out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Oh? Where's CB...
choice_data_list: I'm back like a gust of wind!
I'm back like a gust of wind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because of that, for some reason I was the one who got reprimanded for her stepping into the winner's circle, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu looked completely composed,
as if the wild excitement from earlier had never happened...
Yet deep in her heart, a spark of that heat still seemed to linger—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it will refine
that tremendous burst of speed even further.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B., Symboli Rudolf, and... Mejiro Ramonu. The three of them lined up in the paddock. That sight was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Getting ahead of yourself is a
no-no.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Please bear with it
just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"The Queen Elizabeth II Cup...
A race worthy of reverence awaits me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Like the Victoria Mile, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup is a race targeted by many on the Tiara route.
It carries great prestige, and its winner is showered in honor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning both would prove Mejiro Ramonu's
strength across both mile and middle distances.
choice_data_list: There's a different kind of fun to it, after all.
There's a whole different kind of fun to it, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: For example?
choice_data_list: It could change the way you love racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She ran today's race fiercely, keeping her rivals in mind,
while at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, she set the pace gracefully.
Her way of loving is by no means one-dimensional."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You
just taught me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, riding that high wave of excitement,
she takes on the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!
